cards.title: Core schemas and entity architecture of Material Management
cards.body:
The Material Management module operates across the Purchase and Inventory database schemas.
Purchase transactions populate header tables such as PMPurchaseOrder and detail tables like PMIndentDetail.
Inventory storage and movement records write to IGRNMain, IItemMaster, and IStockPosting entries.

cards.title: Centralized master dependencies and shared lookups
cards.body:
MM transaction forms depend on shared masters including masterdata.mItemMaster and masterdata.mAccountGroup.
Currency exchange rates are resolved from GlobalData.CurrencyMaster and applied during PO valuation.
Vendor locations map to Finance books through the shared GlobalData.VendorLocationSelect lookup routine.

cards.title: Posting boundaries between inventory movements and General Ledger
cards.body:
Inventory transactions generate financial vouchers using Account Determination Rules (ARD).
Material receipts invoke Inventory.IGRNFinancePosting to create valued journal vouchers.
Financial integration verifies division mapping and accounting period lock flags prior to ledger commit.

cards.title: Document lineage tracking via reference headers and line IDs
cards.body:
Transaction lineage flows from Indent to RFQ, Quotation, PO, Gate Entry, and GRN.
Each child document stores the parent document type and yearly document number in RefDocType and RefDocNo.
Status cascades decrement balance quantities on parent detail lines during transaction authorization.

cards.title: Shared custom fields framework integration across MM forms
cards.body:
MM transaction headers integrate the shared UserControl CustomField for extensible user attributes.
Field values load via masterdata.customfieldsloaddata and save through masterdata.customfieldssave.
Custom attribute validation executes dynamically without modifying core transaction table schemas.

cards.title: Optimistic concurrency locking and audit trail mechanics
cards.body:
All MM transaction records enforce optimistic locking using ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy timestamps.
Concurrent modifications trigger reload warnings to prevent overwriting conflicting updates.
Authorized transactions lock key header fields and set document status flags to prevent deletion.
